literal_meaning: ঘরের কোণে বসা (sitting in the corner of the house)
figurative_meaning_en: lazily, idly, without engaging in any work
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সারাদিন ঘরে টায় বসে সময় কাটায়।
চাকরি না করে ঘরে টায় বসে আছে, কোনো উদ্যোগ নেয় না।
example_sentences_in_english: He spends the whole day sitting idly in the corner of the house.
Instead of looking for a job, he just sits idly at home without any initiative.
note: The idiom likely originates from rural Bengali life, evoking images of inactivity in a traditional household setting; 'টায়' refers to a nook or corner in dialectal usage.
